race.comment: Cracking contest. KOHLER KID (11) stretched out nicely late when resuming and will take plenty of holding out late under the light weight if the pace is strong. BALANCE THE BOOKS (8) is another handy one ready to return after enjoying her most successful campaign to date. Profiles very similar to DAGGERS, and perhaps has the upside-edge. Have to take seriously. STREET CHASE (12) is fitter third-up after a close Eagle Farm fourth and a narrow placing behind SPIETHTACULAR at this venue. Definitely worth including. SPIETHTACULAR (9) has returned in great order this campaign and gets a good chance to test herself. Expect Jones to burn across from out there and give another bold sight. CHO OYU (2) made quite the return last month and is another that's in the mix.
